idleTitle: Kua rite koe ki te oma?
idleSub: Peke hei hopu i ngā pai, hei peke whakawhiti i ngā kino.
pausedSub: Pāwhiri, pēhia rānei a Enter hei oma tonu.
editingSub: Ka tāmutu te kēmu i a koe e whakatika ana.
emptyTitle: Kāore anō he mea hei tākaro
emptySub: Tāpirihia he ihirangi ki tēnei kēmu kia taea ai te tākaro.
copyNote: Kua tāruatia. Whakapiria ki te wāhi e hiahia ana koe.
copyFail: Kua tīpakohia te kuputuhi. Tāruatia ki te Ctrl, Cmd rānei + C.
stageLabel: Kēmu oma. Ka oma noa te kiripuaki. Peke hei hopu i ngā huatau pai, hei karo i ngā kino.
stageHow: Pēhia a Space, Enter, te pere ake, W rānei hei peke. Pēhia a Escape hei tāmutu. Pēhia a Tab hei haere tonu. Kei raro hoki i Pānuitia kāore e tākaro ngā mea katoa o te kēmu.
hintKeys: Space, te pere ake, W rānei hei peke
guideText: Hopukia ngā mea o te tohutoro tūāhanga tūāpapa-pūnaha-tukutuku. Pekehia ngā mea ehara i te tukutuku taketake.
badList: Kino: ehara i te tukutuku taketake
recapScore: I tika koe i roto i
